description_en: Applies an automatic snapshot policy to one or more cloud disks
description_zh: 为一块或者多块云盘应用自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecs apply-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp14yziiuvu3s6jn0000 --disk-ids d-bp14k9cxvr5uzy540000_,_d-bp1dtj8v7x6u08iw0000_,_d-bp1c0tyj9tfli2r80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy and cloud disks. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略和云盘所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target automatic snapshot policy
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of one or more cloud disks. The value is a JSON array. Separate multiple cloud disk IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 一块或多块云盘的ID。取值是JSON数组格式，云盘ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: disk_ids
